selection_rule.scope: Tune only B5 cooldown on pilot seeds. These are parameter candidates for one baseline, not additional final methods.
selection_rule.ranking_data: All seven pilot case variants, both batch sizes, both pilot seeds; no final-seed observations.
selection_rule.eligibility: All paired B5/B3 GPU runs must complete correctly. A candidate is stable-eligible when the geometric mean paired B5/B3 stationary runtime ratio is at most 1.02 at each batch size.
selection_rule.objective: Among stable-eligible candidates minimize the equal-cell, equal-seed geometric mean paired B5/B3 runtime ratio across all seven case variants and both batch sizes.
selection_rule.tie_rule: Treat candidates within 1% of the best all-case ratio as tied; choose the largest cooldown among that set to reduce unnecessary churn.
selection_rule.fallback: If no candidate satisfies the stationary pilot constraint, minimize the worst per-batch stationary B5/B3 ratio; among candidates within1% of that score, minimize the all-case ratio; among within1% ties choose the largest cooldown. Report that the pilot constraint was not met.
selection_rule.freeze_rule: Record all three pilot scores and the selected cooldown, then freeze exactly one B5 value before final runs. Pilot scores are selection evidence only, not confirmatory confidence intervals.

interpretation: Descriptive pilot-only parameter selection. B5/B3 runs are paired within each frozen manifest. No confidence interval or final-performance claim is made.
